The Planner incorrectly concluded that because *Laeliocattleya* is not an "accepted genus" in the strict taxonomic sense (it is a hybrid), it is therefore not an orchid. This is a category error: hybrids are still orchids; they are just orchid hybrids. Since both *Broughtonia* and *Laeliocattleya* belong to the family Orchidaceae, both are orchids.
